overview.text: Today's key developments span recursive self-improvement, efficient diffusion architectures, omni-modal parsing, and new AI safety and tooling releases. In recursive self-improvement, A-RSI introduces adaptive task refresh to determine when training experience ceases to be useful. For efficient architectures, Look Only When Needed presents certificate-guided visual routing to reduce redundant decoding computation in diffusion vision-language models. In perception and parsing, Youtu-Parsing-Omni delivers an omni-modal parser converting diverse modalities into structured records grounded in space and time. Meanwhile, research advances explore the Platonic Representation Hypothesis with JEPAs, long-form video editing agents, and real-world benchmarks for multimodal interleaved generation. Releases feature facebook/sam3 alongside new Android deployment tools like jackwener/DSH-Android and wangzan101/Mika. Additionally, OpenAI updated its robots.txt policies for AI training preferences and expanded safety protections, while analysis highlights cyber risks from open models.

entries.title: A-RSI: Adaptive Task Refresh for Zero-Data Multimodal Self-Improvement
entries.summary: Recursive self-improvement requires models not only to acquire useful training experience, but also to decide when their current experience has ceased to be useful.
entries.why: It addresses recursive self-improvement by helping models determine when their current training experience ceases to be useful.

entries.title: Look Only When Needed: Certificate-Guided Visual Routing for Efficient Diffusion VLMs
entries.summary: Diffusion vision-language models (DVLMs) process their entire input at every denoising step. Since visual tokens make up 89-97% of this input on the benchmarks we study, most of the decoding computation is spent repeatedly processing the same image.
entries.why: It reduces redundant decoding computation in diffusion vision-language models through certificate-guided visual routing.

entries.title: Youtu-Parsing-Omni: One Encoder, One Schema, All Modalities
entries.summary: We present Youtu-Parsing-Omni, an omni-modal parser that converts documents, images, audio, and video into structured records grounded in space and time, providing a perception layer for agents that read, locate, and cite evidence across modalities.
entries.why: It provides a unified perception layer that converts documents, images, audio, and video into grounded structured records.

entries.title: Proving and Improving the Platonic Representation Hypothesis with JEPAs
entries.summary: Whether models trained on different modalities converge to the same representation of the world is central to AI. The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) conjectures that they do as they scale, but without a proof it offers neither a guarantee nor a recipe.
entries.why: It investigates whether models trained on different modalities converge to the same representation using JEPAs.

entries.title: WeVisCut: The Whole Editing Room in One Agent From Narration to Long-Form Video
entries.summary: Producing long-form videos from narration requires interdependent decisions that remain coherent across shots. Existing agentic editors often use multi-stage workflows driven by general models, leaving the quality-cost trade-off of compact, task-adapted policies unclear.
entries.why: It explores compact, task-adapted policies for maintaining narrative coherence across shots in long-form video editing.

entries.title: IntReal: A Real-World Dataset and Benchmark for Multimodal Interleaved Generation
entries.summary: Humans routinely consume multimodal content, where textual and visual information is naturally interleaved. Although Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) can jointly generate text and images, multimodal interleaved generation remains largely underexplored.
entries.why: It introduces a dataset and benchmark for evaluating interleaved text and image generation in unified multimodal models.

entries.title: WebAnything: From the Wild Web to Scalable Agent Environments
entries.summary: Web agents require diverse, executable, and resettable website environments for reproducible training and evaluation. Human-assisted mirrors demand per-site engineering, while generative construction can diverge from specified real websites.
entries.why: It tackles the need for diverse, executable, and resettable website environments for scalable web agent training.

entries.title: facebook/sam3
entries.why: It offers mask-generation capabilities via transformers for computer vision tasks.

entries.title: jackwener/DSH-Android
entries.summary: 免 ROOT 免 Termux，一个 APK 在安卓手机上跑 DeepSeek Harness。引擎内嵌 App 进程 · 读屏操作 App · 改系统设置 · 定时/条件自动化 · 可选 Shizuku · Kotlin
entries.why: It enables running DeepSeek Harness directly inside an Android app process without root access.

entries.title: wangzan101/Mika
entries.summary: Mika — 你手机上的私人 AI 助理，替你操作 App、上网、把事办成。An on-device AI agent for Android that operates apps and the web to get things done for you. · Kotlin
entries.why: It provides an on-device AI agent for Android designed to operate apps and the web autonomously.

entries.title: Making it easier for websites to express AI training preferences
entries.summary: OpenAI will honor a shared robots.txt signal to help website operators communicate their AI training preferences to participating providers.
entries.why: It offers a shared signal for website operators to communicate AI training preferences to participating providers.

entries.title: Community safety report and new protections for teens
entries.summary: OpenAI is strengthening violence prevention in ChatGPT with expanded safeguards, earlier interventions, and a new commitment to public safety reporting.
entries.why: It strengthens violence prevention and introduces expanded safeguards and safety reporting for teens in ChatGPT.

entries.title: Was I wrong about open models & cyber risks?
entries.summary: Last week coined the term “Black October“ after an onslaught of critical vulnerability disclosures, including PHP2Shell and GitLab, signified the moment when the cyber risks of AI models started to materialize.
entries.why: It examines how recent vulnerability disclosures signify the materialization of cyber risks from open models.

entries.title: Childhood and Education #22: Voice Without Exit
entries.summary: Nikole Hannah-Jones wrote a brave self-critical piece in The New York Times, centrally about how she intentionally sent her daughter to a well-funded but failing school, PS 307, in the hopes of using voice to improve it, and how that utterly failed her daughter and failed to…
entries.why: It reflects on personal experiences with school integration efforts and institutional failure.

entries.title: Building Reasoning Models from the Ground Up: A Full Video Course
entries.summary: Over 11 hours of coding videos on evaluation, inference-time scaling, reinforcement learning, and distillation, with Python and PyTorch.
entries.why: It delivers coding resources covering inference-time scaling, reinforcement learning, and reasoning model distillation.
